info.name: IntelliScribe Court Transcription API v1
info.description:
Complete REST API for court audio upload, transcription, editing, finalization, translation, and document download.

All endpoints (except `/api/v1/health`) require a Firebase ID token set in the `{{firebase_token}}` collection variable.

variable.description: Base URL of the IntelliScribe API server
Firebase ID token obtained from Firebase Authentication
Transcript item ID used across transcript endpoints
Job ID returned from an upload or post-process request

item.name: Audio Upload
item.description: Endpoints for uploading court audio files and creating transcription jobs.

formdata.description: Audio file(s) to upload (WAV, MP3, FLAC, M4A, etc.)

request.description: Upload one or more audio files to create a transcription job. Returns the job object with an `id` and initial `status` of `queued`.

response.name: 202 — Job Queued
response.body:
{
  "id": "job_abc123",
  "status": "queued",
  "message": "Audio uploaded successfully. Transcription queued.",
  "fileName": "hearing_20241115.wav",
  "fileNames": ["hearing_20241115.wav"],
  "hearingDate": "2024-11-15",
  "caseNumber": "CASE-2024-001234",
  "transcript": null,
  "errorCode": null,
  "error": null
}

item.name: Jobs
item.description: Endpoints for querying transcription job status.

request.description: Poll for the current status of a transcription or post-processing job. Poll until `status` is `completed`, `failed`, `post_processing_complete`, or `cancelled`.

response.name: 200 — Processing
response.body:
{
  "id": "job_abc123",
  "status": "processing",
  "message": "Transcription in progress (segment 3 of 8)",
  "fileName": "hearing_20241115.wav",
  "fileNames": ["hearing_20241115.wav"],
  "hearingDate": "2024-11-15",
  "caseNumber": "CASE-2024-001234",
  "transcript": null,
  "errorCode": null,
  "error": null
}

response.name: 200 — Completed
response.body:
{
  "id": "job_abc123",
  "status": "completed",
  "message": "Transcription completed successfully.",
  "fileName": "hearing_20241115.wav",
  "fileNames": ["hearing_20241115.wav"],
  "hearingDate": "2024-11-15",

item.name: Transcripts
item.description: Endpoints for listing, retrieving, editing, finalizing, and post-processing transcripts.

request.description: Returns all dates that have at least one transcript, plus a recommended `defaultDate` for initial display.
Returns all transcript items for the given date. Each item contains metadata; use the single transcript endpoint to fetch full content.

response.name: 200 — Transcripts for Date
response.body:
{
  "date": "2024-11-15",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "2024-11-15_CASE-2024-001234",
      "date": "2024-11-15",
      "folderName": "2024-11-15_CASE-2024-001234",
      "caseNumber": "CASE-2024-001234",
      "court": "High Court of Colombo",
      "uploadedBy": "reporter@courts.lk",
      "finalized": false,
      "audioAvailable": true,
      "hasSrt": true,
      "proceedingAvailable": false,
      "translations": [],
      "files": []
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Retrieve the full transcript record including `transcriptText`, `editedTranscriptText`, `finalizedTranscriptText`, translations, and file metadata.

response.name: 200 — Full Transcript
response.body:
{
  "id": "2024-11-15_CASE-2024-001234",
  "date": "2024-11-15",
  "folderName": "2024-11-15_CASE-2024-001234",
  "caseNumber": "CASE-2024-001234",
  "court": "High Court of Colombo",
  "uploadedBy": "reporter@courts.lk",
  "transcriptText": "JUDGE: Good morning. This is case number CASE-2024-001234...",
  "editedTranscriptText": null,
  "finalizedTranscriptText": null,
  "finalized": false,
  "translations": [],
  "files": [
    {"name": "transcript_original.docx", "size": 32768, "updatedAt": "2024-11-15T09:45:00Z"}
  ],
  "audioAvailable": true,
  "hasSrt": true,
  "proceedingAvailable": false
}

request.description: Save a human-edited version of the transcript text. This can be called multiple times; each call overwrites the previous edit. Returns the updated TranscriptItem.

response.name: 200 — Edited Saved
response.body:
{
  "id": "2024-11-15_CASE-2024-001234",
  "date": "2024-11-15",
  "caseNumber": "CASE-2024-001234",
  "editedTranscriptText": "JUDGE: Good morning. This is case number CASE-2024-001234.\nCOURT REPORTER: Proceeding commenced at 09:00 AM.",
  "finalized": false,
  "audioAvailable": true
}

request.description: Finalize and lock the transcript. Once finalized, the `finalized` flag is `true` and the content cannot be changed. Returns the updated TranscriptItem.

response.name: 200 — Finalized
response.body:
{
  "id": "2024-11-15_CASE-2024-001234",
  "date": "2024-11-15",
  "caseNumber": "CASE-2024-001234",
  "finalizedTranscriptText": "JUDGE: Good morning. This is case number CASE-2024-001234.\nCOURT REPORTER: Proceeding commenced at 09:00 AM.",
  "finalized": true,
  "audioAvailable": true
}

request.description: Trigger AI post-processing: generate a formatted court proceedings document, translate into specified languages (BCP-47 codes), and optionally produce a summary. Returns an UploadJob to track progress.

response.name: 202 — Post-Processing Job Created
response.body:
{
  "id": "job_xyz789",
  "status": "queued",
  "message": "Post-processing queued: translations (si, ta) + summary.",
  "fileName": null,
  "hearingDate": "2024-11-15",
  "caseNumber": "CASE-2024-001234",
  "transcript": null,
  "errorCode": null,
  "error": null
}

item.name: Downloads
item.description: Endpoints for streaming/downloading audio and transcript documents.

request.description: Download the raw audio file bytes. Returns the full file with appropriate audio MIME type. Use the stream endpoint for in-browser playback with range support.

header.description: Optional: request a byte range for partial content (e.g. seeking)

query.description: Filename of the audio file in storage
Firebase ID token (passed as query param for audio element compatibility)

request.description: Stream audio with HTTP Range support. Authentication is provided via the `token` query parameter (not the Authorization header) to allow use as an `<audio src="...">` URL.
Download the auto-generated transcript as a DOCX file.
Download the human-edited transcript as a DOCX file.
Download the finalized and locked transcript as a DOCX file.
Download the SubRip (SRT) subtitle file for the transcript.
Download the AI-generated summary document as a DOCX file (requires post-processing with `include_summary: true`).
Download all translations combined into a single DOCX file.

query.description: Filename to retrieve from the transcript's storage folder

request.description: Retrieve any named file from a transcript's storage folder by filename. Useful for fetching individual translation documents or other generated files listed in `TranscriptItem.files`.
Returns the health status of the API server. No authentication required. Use this for load balancer health probes and uptime monitors.
